careers.name: Machine Learning Engineer
careers.summary: Build systems that learn from data, such as recommendations, vision and language models.
qualifications: B.Tech in CSE / AI & ML / Data Science (or B.Sc Computer Science, then M.Sc / M.Tech)

careers.name: Clinical Psychologist
careers.summary: Assess and treat mental health conditions using therapy and psychological testing.
qualifications: MA / M.Sc Psychology, then an RCI-recognised clinical psychology programme (M.Phil or equivalent)

careers.name: Chartered Accountant (CA)
careers.summary: Handle accounting, auditing, taxation and financial advice for people and businesses.
qualifications: Class 12 (Commerce is common, but any stream can register)
ICAI CA course: Foundation, Intermediate, Final, plus practical training (articleship)

careers.name: Indian Audit and Accounts Service Officer
tags: indian audit and accounts service officer

careers.name: Cricketer
careers.summary: Play cricket professionally at club, state, national or league level.
qualifications: No fixed degree, but academy training from a young age
Class 12 completion is strongly recommended as a backup
exams: District and state age-group selections (U-14, U-16, U-19)
Domestic tournaments such as Ranji Trophy

careers.name: Commercial Pilot
careers.summary: Fly aircraft for airlines, charter or cargo operators.
qualifications: Class 12 with Physics and Maths (usual requirement)
DGCA Commercial Pilot Licence from an approved flying school
